3. Consider setting aside dedicated time for hobbies or activities outside of your usual routine. This can help re-engage your interest in each other and prevent stagnation.
4. Seek support from friends or family when needed. Having a strong support system can make a big difference in managing relationship challenges.
5. If the situation feels unmanageable, don't hesitate to reach out for professional help, whether that's counseling or guidance
